title: Critique: patients stay conscious after extensive frontal damage

statements.text: Well-documented patients stayed conscious after bilateral frontal lobectomy, near-total frontal resection, psychosurgery or a spike through both frontal lobes, and frontal regions may modulate the neural correlates of consciousness rather than contribute to them, so frontal cortex is not necessary for consciousness.

sources.quote: At a minimum, reports of conscious patients after bilateral frontal lobectomy demonstrate that the frontal cortex is not necessary for consciousness.
suggesting that these frontal regions may modulate the NCC rather than contributing directly to them (Kozuch, 2014)
